entry.title: Prototype Design Pattern in Python...
entry.summary: The prototype design pattern is a creational pattern. If the creation of an object is a very costly affair and we already have a similar kind of object, instead of creating it each time we need it, we use the clone of the object that is already there. Suppose, there is a large object with many attributes whose data we read from a database. We need to modify that data multiple times in our program. So instead of creating the object each time by reading from the database, we tend to keep a prototype object - we clone it, and then work on it. In Python, there is a module called copy which has two methods - copy() and deepcopy(). The first one is for the shallow copy and the second one is for the deepcopy.
